{{Quote|An invitation made with five swamp stunners isn't an invitation. It's an order.|Han Solo, to Iisner|<ref name="The New Rebellion">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>}}
The '''swamp stunner''' was a type of weapon that was wielded by various members of the [[Glottalphib]] gang of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nandreeson]], who operated from the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Skip 6]] on the [[Smuggler's Run/Legends|Smuggler's Run]] during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The weapons were snub-nosed in appearance and emitted blue-colored energy bolts when fired, which could inflict intense pain onto any individual they struck. In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], Nadreeson's [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Iisner]] and four other Glottalphibs discharged swamp stunners on [[Skip 5]] while [[Skirmish on Skip 5|attempting]] to capture the former [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].
